Your leagues

Sleeper account

Set by this server's configuration. The service reports on this account while your browser is closed. Moves still happen in Sleeper.

Scheduled summaries

Reports are saved here. With phone notifications set up below, they are also sent to your phone.

Important opportunities

Each scan sends at most one notification listing everything new. The first scan only records what already exists, so you hear about changes and not the backlog. Anything found during quiet hours is sent when they end. Matching quiet-hour times turn quiet hours off. Injury alerts await a timely data source.

Phone notifications

Awaker sends pushes through ntfy. No account is needed: pick a topic nobody could guess, save it, then subscribe to the same topic in the ntfy app on your phone.

On a public server anyone who knows the topic can read your notifications, so treat it like a password.

My ntfy server needs an access token

A saved token stays on the server and is never shown again. Changing the server removes it.

Agent access & previews

Agents can inspect status, find or evaluate trades, inspect waiver/lineup opportunities, and preview summaries. They cannot change your team or send messages.

Start the MCP adapter with node server/mcp.js and your read-only agent token. Connection instructions are in docs/integrations.md.
